title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 18
description: Ten questions on Revelation 18: the angel's cry over Babylon the great, the merchants and sailors who mourn her, and the millstone cast into the sea.

questions.text: What happened to the earth when the angel with great authority came down out of the sky?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:1 says the earth was illuminated with the glory of the angel who came down out of the sky.

answers.text: It was illuminated with his glory

questions.text: According to the angel's mighty voice, what has fallen Babylon become?
questions.explanation: The angel cried that fallen Babylon has become a habitation of demons and a prison of every unclean spirit and of every unclean and hateful bird.

answers.text: A city of kings and princes

questions.text: Who grew rich from the abundance of Babylon's luxury?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:3 says the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.

questions.text: What did the voice from heaven tell God's people to do?
questions.explanation: The voice from heaven said, "Come out of her, my people", so that they would have no participation in her sins and not receive of her plagues.

answers.text: Trade with her no more but stay

questions.text: What does Babylon say in her heart about herself?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:7 quotes her as saying in her heart, "I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning."

answers.text: "I sit a queen, and am no widow"
"I am poor and in need of nothing"
"I am the mother of the nations"

questions.text: Which plagues does the text say will come upon her in one day?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:8 says that in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine, and she will be utterly burned with fire.

questions.text: What did those who make their living by sea do as they mourned over her?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:19 says they cast dust on their heads and cried, weeping and mourning over the great city.

answers.text: They sailed into the city to help
They cast dust on their heads

questions.text: The long list of the merchants' merchandise ends with which item?
questions.explanation: The list in Revelation 18:13 ends with wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people's bodies and souls.

questions.text: What did the mighty angel take up and cast into the sea?
questions.explanation: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying that Babylon would be thrown down in the same way.

answers.text: A golden cup of mixed wine
A stone like a great millstone

questions.text: Whose voice will be heard no more at all in her?
questions.explanation: Revelation 18:23 says the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in her, and the light of a lamp will shine no more in her.

answers.text: The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride
The voice of her kings and princes
The voice of her children in the streets
The voice of the angel from the sky
